name: Plot average epochs by conditions
summary: Averages epoched MEG/EEG data per condition with MNE-Python and plots each evoked response (butterfly plus topographies), outputting PNG figures and an HTML report.
description: Computes Epochs.average() for every event type in the epochs and draws Evoked.plot_joint figures, collected in an HTML report with dataset statistics. Use it as a visual check of ERPs/ERFs after epoching. It takes no parameters.

inputs.description: Epoched MEG/EEG data in MNE epochs .fif format, with event labels for each condition.

outputs.description: HTML report with the evoked response of every condition.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, Heinsfeld AS, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods 21:809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
